notes: Adds recovery, expiration enforcement, and test coverage to complete lock lifecycle.

change_log.note: Adds TTL enforcement beyond Mongo TTL index
Supports controlled manual unlock for incidents
Ensures correctness under concurrency and failure

stories.title: Lock Expiration Enforcement Worker
stories.description: Implement a background process to actively detect and clean up expired locks, ensuring immediate availability rather than relying solely on MongoDB TTL index delays. The worker must scan for expired locks and mark them as released or expired.

stories.title: Lock Recovery and Takeover Logic
stories.description: Implement safe lock takeover logic allowing a new process to acquire a lock if the existing lock is expired or the owner is unresponsive. Must validate expiration timestamp and ensure atomic takeover to prevent race conditions.

stories.title: Admin Override and Forced Unlock
stories.description: Provide a controlled mechanism for administrative override of locks, enabling forced unlock using a secure key or authorized context. Must log override reason and enforce audit traceability.

stories.title: Locking System Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, renewal, expiration, recovery, and override scenarios including concurrent access and failure cases.
